const staticData = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
if (!staticData.allLeads) staticData.allLeads = [];

const item = $input.all()[0].json;
staticData.allLeads.push({
  company: item.company_data.name,
  website: item.company_data.website,
  industry: (item.company_data.industry_indicators || []).join(', '),
  tech_stack: (item.company_data.tech_stack_indicators || []).join(', '),
  full_name: item.lead.full_name,
  job_title: item.lead.job_title,
  email: item.lead.email,
  email_verified: item.lead.email_verified ? 'Ja' : 'Nein',
  email_status: item.lead.email_status,
  email_confidence: item.lead.email_confidence,
  linkedin_url: item.lead.linkedin_url,
  location: item.lead.location,
  headline: item.lead.headline,
  meddic_score: item.lead.meddic_score,
  meddic_category: item.lead.meddic_category,
  metrics_score: item.lead.meddic_details.metrics.score,
  metrics_reason: item.lead.meddic_details.metrics.reason,
  economic_buyer_score: item.lead.meddic_details.economic_buyer.score,
  economic_buyer_reason: item.lead.meddic_details.economic_buyer.reason,
  decision_criteria_score: item.lead.meddic_details.decision_criteria.score,
  decision_criteria_reason: item.lead.meddic_details.decision_criteria.reason,
  decision_process_score: item.lead.meddic_details.decision_process.score,
  decision_process_reason: item.lead.meddic_details.decision_process.reason,
  identify_pain_score: item.lead.meddic_details.identify_pain.score,
  identify_pain_reason: item.lead.meddic_details.identify_pain.reason,
  champion_score: item.lead.meddic_details.champion.score,
  champion_reason: item.lead.meddic_details.champion.reason,
  campaign: item.campaign.name,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
});

return $input.all();

parameters.content:
## PHASE 1: Firmen-Analyse
Scrape Website → Extract Info (Branche, Tech-Stack)

## PHASE 2: LinkedIn Personen finden
Phantombuster Search → Parse → Deduplicate

## PHASE 3: Email Finder (Prospeo)
LinkedIn Email Finder → Fallback → Process Result

## PHASE 4: Email Verification (Bouncer)
Verify → Filter deliverable/risky only

## PHASE 5: MEDDIC Scoring + Excel Export
Score (0-100) → Collect → Excel → Filter WARM+HOT

## PHASE 6: Email Outreach (Microsoft Graph)
Build Email → Check Limit → Send via Outlook → Log

## TRIGGER & INPUT
Manual oder Webhook → Validate → Split Companies
